g.title: dataflow
g.text: IMG-OPT-05 Optomechanical stability: data flow of the result fields (ANALYSIS)
solid blue = stage writes the field, dashed grey = stage reads it; italic = property (derived)

a.xlink:title: Run the IMG-OPT-05 analysis for each data state (one frame sequence each).

Measure the pupil centre (pupil_centre) of each frame of the run (BCKGD_SUBTED), one frame at a time, and the frame times (DATE-OBS). Warns if the sequence's span differs from the run's timescale by more than span_tolerance.
OUTPUTS: - StabilityRunResult, with times, centres, centre_sigmas, radii

FYI plot in result.results_dir: the measured pupil offsets (mas on sky) vs. time, with their noise, and the injected offsets (SHIFT_X/Y) if there; and the offsets in the x-y plane with the limit as a circle.
OUTPUTS: - list[str]: written plot files

Log the outcome of the run's requirement (as decided by metis_5422_check) and compare it with the injected truth (EXPECTED).
OUTPUTS: - StabilityRunResult, with verdict_overall and consistent set

Log a table of all runs (requirement, instrument, timescale, case, RMS, verdict, expected, consistency with the injected truth); METIS-1230 is NOT EVALUATED (no SIM data).
OUTPUTS: - int: number of runs inconsistent with the injected truth
